tasks.prompt: Sum the limit field of every services/*.json file whose status is active. End with exactly: total_limit=<n>.
Find the service with the highest limit across services/*.json. If two services tie, choose the lower id. End with exactly: service=<id>; limit=<n>.
Find the owner of service svc-217, then count how many services have that same owner. End with exactly: owner=<name>; count=<n>.
Count the services whose notes field contains the word canary. End with exactly: canary=<n>.
Set the limit of service svc-042 to 999 in services/svc-042.json. Change nothing else. End with exactly: changed=services/svc-042.json; limit=999.
